title: Phones
description: Use the SoftGlaze phone app with this computer: see your profiles, start and stop them, and answer AI requests from your phone. Everything between the phone and this computer is end to end encrypted.
offOwner: Turn this on to pair a phone. This computer then keeps a secure connection to the SoftGlaze relay, which only passes encrypted messages along.
offOther: The Owner has not turned on the phone companion.

relay.authFailed: The relay refused this computer. Check the relay address in Advanced.

pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.help: Install SoftGlaze on your phone, then scan a code from this screen.
pair.qrAlt: Pairing code for the SoftGlaze phone app
pair.scanTitle: Scan this code with the SoftGlaze phone app
pair.step2: Go to Settings, Pair with a PC, and scan this code.
pair.step3: Check that both screens show the same six digits.
pair.expiresIn: The code works once and ends in {{time}}.
pair.textTitle: Cannot scan? Copy the code as text
pair.attemptFailed: A phone tried a wrong or damaged code. The code is still open.

confirm.title: {{name}} wants to pair
confirm.help: Only continue if your phone shows exactly these six digits.
confirm.helpBrowser: Only continue if the browser shows exactly these six digits. A browser can see profiles and answer AI requests; tick Start and stop profiles only if you want that too.
confirm.name: Phone name

view.label: See profiles and status
view.help: Always on. Only profiles the member can see.

control_profiles.label: Start and stop profiles
control_profiles.help: Same rules as on this computer.

approve_ai.label: Answer AI requests
approve_ai.help: Allow or deny actions of AI apps, for tokens this member may answer.

approve_team.label: Answer team requests
approve_team.help: Approve access requests from team members.

totp.label: Show 2FA codes
totp.help: Two step codes saved in profiles.

phone_profiles_linked.label: Sync profiles
phone_profiles_linked.help: Profiles you choose below also open on this phone.

devices.title: Phones and browsers
devices.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? It stops working with this computer at once and has to pair again.

sync.title: Profile sync
sync.help: Chosen profiles also open in the phone app. Settings, start pages and cookies follow the profile; a profile opens on one device at a time.
sync.noPhone: No phone may sync yet. Give a phone the Sync profiles permission above.
sync.offConfirm: Stop syncing {{name}}? Phones keep their copy.
sync.removeAll: Remove all synced data from the relay
sync.removeAllConfirm: Remove every synced profile from the relay? Profiles on this computer and on phones stay as they are.
sync.lastError: Last sync failed ({{code}}). It tries again every minute.
sync.limits: Site storage, extensions, saved passwords and downloads do not sync. Proxy passwords sync only where you allow it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.pcName: Name of this computer on phones
advanced.resetConfirm: Reset the phone keys of this computer? Every paired phone is removed and has to pair again.

errors.load: Could not load the phone settings.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Phones are not available in this build.
